text: Ninigi came down from heaven through eight layers of clouds to the top of Mount Takachiho, on the island of Kyushu.
spoken: Neeneegee came down from heaven through eight layers of clouds to the top of Mount Tahkahcheeho, on the island of Kyooshoo.

pauzy.regula: przecinek, po samogłosce, po nazwie, długie słowo (4 syl.)
